meta.title: Scenario: large department (Ledger Operations Centre)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-scenarios.ts (large-department) with seed 20261105. 64 members, all with the team value Operations: the HR record holds no team below the department. Ties follow seating on two floors (neighbours know each other, ties fade with distance), shifts (Early and Late overlap less), eight supervisors whose reports are spread across the floor rather than seated together, and about 90 scattered acquaintances. Eight remote members are tied mostly to their supervisor. Colleagues a respondent did not know were recorded as 0 on the scaled layers and as “does not apply” on valence, as a survey with selection records them. OPS20, OPS59 and OPS62 answered about two thirds of the survey; about 3 % of other ratings are missing.
